none: PAS NARC-733D28: Roman nail cleaner, profile
contea di ritrovamento: Northamptonshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A beautiful example of a cast copper-alloy Roman nail cleaner. The object is 55 mm in length. The head of the article is actually designed as a female head with tied back hair. To the reverse of the head is a suspension loop, at a right angle to the blade of the cleaner.
